A <br> inside an inline code span splits the span and emits a hard break

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*

fun main() {
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>X <code>A<br>B<br>C</code></p>", null)
    println(result.content)
}
```
